body.statement: Every solution of \(A\Sigma+\Sigma A^{\top}=D(d)\) has the unique representation \[A(d,q;\Sigma)=\frac1\Delta\begin{pmatrix}du/2+qt&-dt/2-qs\\-(1-d)t/2+qu&(1-d)s/2-qt\end{pmatrix}.\] Conversely, every \((d,q)\in(0,1)\times\mathbb R\) in this representation solves the Lyapunov equation and has eigenvalues with strictly positive real parts, so \(-A\) is Hurwitz.
body.justification: The affine fiber turns a nonidentified matrix inverse problem into a two-coordinate exact feasibility problem.
body.gap: DettlingHomsAmendolaDrtonHansen2023 identifies the two-cycle rank defect but does not give this time-gauged unknown-diffusion parametrization as a polarity-analysis object.
body.consumer: The four sector programs and every explicit witness use this common coordinate system.
